title: Turning the Battlefield into a Home
summary: Light and Dark try to turn the third field into their battlefield until Shahmaran reframes knowledge, power, and responsibility and Maran opens the Common Center with responsibility as its key.

links.note: Light cannot define the shared world alone.
Dark cannot define the shared world alone.
The Common Center becomes institutionalized as an open distributed network.
Its values require explicit non-negotiable and adaptable rules.

prompt.en: Write a third option that limits both powers while preserving what is valuable in each.
prompt.tr: Her iki gücü sınırlayan, fakat ikisinin de değerli yanını koruyan üçüncü bir kural yazın.
